Hello! I would like to request a full color piece of my favorite Vtuber Ayase Yuu. I would like to leave the design of the outfit as well as pose and expression, completely up to you. You will have total creative control over the artwork and my character for this request. I do wish, if possible to have a night time cyberpunk city in the background, with neon signs and light rain. (if you cannot that is totally fine.) Thank you very much. Here are her references

https://imgur.com/a/ayase-yuu-refernces-9ssHIQD

https://imgur.com/a/ayase-yuu-refernces-9ssHIQD

Dear Ten-san,
Nice to meet you, I'm Kota Kotonya, an overseas VTuber. I really like your work, so I am happy to receive your appeal!

If you will accept, I would like to request a sketch sheet of my VTuber.

References:
https://refsheet.net/thatmilka/kota

Character traits:
- 26 year old male
- 157 cm
- Slender, toned body with moles
- Confident and playful

I will leave the poses and details to you.

If it’s okay, I would like to use the drawing for thumbnails and video materials for SNS, YouTube, Twitch, etc.

Thank you very much for listening to my request!
